{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
real_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = real_orders[real_orders['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Final confirmation: no QA orders in completed_orders
qa_check = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
assert len(qa_check) == 0, "QA orders still present in completed_orders!"

# Final output: print the mean revenue as a bare number
mean_revenue"}
